{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 2.16

|arg= local

|eff= local

|gr1= Object Manipulation

|descr= Set an object's water filling.

|s1= obj [[setWaterFillPercentage]] level

|p1= obj: [[Object]] - object to manipulate

|p2= level: [[Number]] - water level in range 0..1 (empty to full)

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>
if (getWaterLeakiness _myCar > 0 && surfaceIsWater getPosASL _myCar) then
{
	_myCar setWaterFillPercentage 1;
	hint "I told you not to go in the water!";
};
</sqf>

|seealso= [[setWaterLeakiness]] [[getWaterLeakiness]] [[getWaterFillPercentage]]
}}
